title: ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENT COMMITTEE REPORT relative to amending the Low Impact Development (LID) Ordinance to establish a pathway for 500 to 2,499 square foot…
text:
[Council File 26-0742]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENT COMMITTEE REPORT relative to amending the Low Impact Development (LID) Ordinance to establish a pathway for 500 to 2,499 square foot projects to be released from prior LID compliance requirements.
Recommendation for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Rodriguez – Blumenfield):
REQUEST the City Attorney, in consultation with the Bureau of Sanitation, prepare and present an ordinance amending the LID Ordinance to establish an administrative release pathway for projects in the 500 to 2,499 square foot impervious area range currently pending under the prior LID Ordinance (Ordinance No. 183833), allowing such projects to be released from these LID compliance requirements and instead subject to the applicability thresholds of the current ordinance (Ordinance No. 188125).
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Motion to amend the Low Impact Development Ordinance so projects of 500 to 2,499 square feet can be released from earlier stormwater compliance requirements.
